name: POST /api/admin/accounts/:id/credits - Grant or revoke bonus credits
description:
Grants or revokes bonus document credits. MUTATING, so the Authorization header carries the step-up token, NOT the login token. Credits sit on top of the plan quota — the monthly allowance is always consumed first and credits only apply once it is exhausted. Reason is mandatory and recorded in the append-only ledger with the acting admin. Revoking more than the balance clamps to zero rather than going negative.

For a team member the credits are held by the TEAM OWNER, because team usage is tracked against the owner's quota.

errorCases.when: The :id path parameter is not a valid UUID
action is missing or not a recognised value

errorCases.message: A reason is required and is recorded in the audit log
Credit amount must be a positive whole number
errorCases.when: amount is zero, negative or fractional

errorCases.message: expires_at must be a valid date
Step-up verification required for this action
errorCases.when: The Authorization header carries a plain admin session token rather than an elevated step-up token
No account exists with that id
